pages.text: The $(bold)Grow Pot$() lets you grow any weed strain crop $(bold)indoors$() without farmland or sunlight. It acts as the grow medium for potted cultivation.$(br)$(br)Place the Grow Pot down and right-click it with any weed seeds to plant them. The crop grows inside the pot. Harvest when fully grown.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Tip:$() Pair with $(bold)LED Light$() or $(bold)HPS Lamp$() above the pot and a $(bold)Reflector$() to boost growth speed. Apply $(bold)Fertilizers$() to the pot to boost THC and CBD values of the harvested buds.
